QuestInfo.name: [LINE FRIENDS] A Suitcase Full of Souvenirs
QuestInfo.0: CONY has gusto to spare, and she's got a favor she'd like you to help her out with. You don't know what it is, but you've done enough quests to have a good idea where this is going.
QuestInfo.1: CONY has gusto to spare, and she's got a favor she'd like you to help her out with. You don't know what it is, but you've done enough quests to have a good idea where this is going.
QuestInfo.2:
CONY asked you to bring her trendy souvenirs that show off the best of Maple World.
She's already made a list, in fact, so now it's up to you to bring her what she requests each day.
